lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters between the first and second dorsal fins, with higher density in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of moderately elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal blob rows, creating a rectangular grid of local maxima posterior to the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge feature is visible between the first and second dorsal fins, marked by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels dorsally to shadow-region pixels ventrally.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: First dorsal fin contains approximately 12-18 distinct high-luminance blobs distributed across the fin surface, with a concentration along the anterior edge.
